title: ECL edit-proposal profile v1
description: Kupo-emitted verified edit-proposal, wrapped by an ECL envelope. Validates the YAML frontmatter only; the richer body schema (search/replace blocks, verification, sandbox) is owned by Kupo's own repo (Rynaro/Kupo schemas/kupo-edit-proposal.v1.json) and MUST be a strict subset of this profile.

verifier.description: The NAMED external verifier that proved the edit GREEN (e.g. 'pytest tests/x.py::y', 'tsc --noEmit', 'ruff check src/').

verifier_class.description: Class of the named external verifier.

verifier_result.description: Kupo emits PROPOSE only after a green external signal (pre-completion gate). An edit-proposal is verified by construction.

target_count.description: Number of files the proposal edits — KEEP scope is <= 2 files.
